name: Bones of the Coven (Coven)
body:
Your body is reinforced by your coven’s magic.

Prerequisite(s): Caster level 1st, coven member.

Benefit(s): When a coven-mate targets you with a harmless spell, you gain a number of temporary hit points equal to that spell’s level. The temporary hit points fade in an hour or when the spell’s duration ends, whichever comes first, and do not stack with other applications of this feat.
